changelog.title: What's New
items: ✨ feat(db): add hideFromQuickPicks and migrate database 46 to 48
✨ feat(app): integrate Jellyfin and Navidrome support
✨ feat(dsp): add DSP core processing module
✨ feat(domain): add shared domain module from Echo Music

changelog.title: Fixes
items: 🔧 fix(playlist): show top playlist download state with the shared helper
🔧 fix(playlist): show auto playlist download state with the shared helper
🔧 fix(playlist): show online playlist download state with the shared helper
🔧 fix(playlist): show local playlist download state with the shared helper
🔧 fix(album): show downloading while any track of the album is in progress
🔧 fix(downloads): keep download state in sync and record completed downloads with their finish time
🔧 fix(settings): open integrations from search and settings without a crash
🔧 fix(scrobble): scrobble queue and shuffle tracks and local media
🔧 fix(spotify): allow only web pages in the Spotify import web view
🔧 fix(login): block file and content access in the sign-in web view
🔧 fix(export): run FFmpeg with an argument list instead of a shell string
🔧 fix(links): encode deep link ids before they become navigation routes
🔧 fix(auto): keep covers in memory so the first metadata update already carries them
🔧 fix(player): keep playing after the app is closed by default
🔧 fix: compile error in the database wrapper, clean artist names, car-connect autoplay, addon track ids; version 1.4.4
🔧 fix(build): resolve compile errors in the home view model, database wrapper, music service and Music Flow repository
🔧 fix(musicflow): restore the trailing comma in the repository's filter arguments
🔧 fix: stop the background service after task clear, stable download order, and block unsafe AI endpoints
